blocks.title: Warehousing support for cargo moving through Kenya
blocks.body: Kenya Tradex provides secure, scalable warehousing solutions strategically located in Mombasa (near the port) and Nairobi (regional distribution hub) . We offer both bonded warehousing for duty-deferred storage and private warehousing for general cargo. Our facilities feature 24/7 security and CCTV monitoring to ensure your cargo is protected at all times.
items: Bonded Warehousing – Duty-deferred storage for imported goods (customs bond)
Private Warehousing – General cargo storage with full duty paid
24/7 Security & CCTV Monitoring – Fully secured facilities with round-the-clock protection
Inventory Management & Stock Reporting – Real-time visibility of your cargo
Cross-Docking & Order Fulfillment – Rapid redistribution for time-sensitive cargo
Short-term (Daily/Weekly) & Long-term Contracts – Flexible terms to match your needs
Pick & Pack Services – Ready for distribution and last-mile delivery
Cargo Insurance Available – Comprehensive coverage options for peace of mind

blocks.title: Warehousing locations and use cases
blocks.body: Storage needs can vary depending on whether the cargo is linked to port activity, inland distribution, project logistics or multi-country delivery planning. Kenya Tradex supports warehousing needs linked to both Mombasa and Nairobi operations.
items: Mombasa Warehouse: Minutes from Mombasa port — ideal for rapid cargo transfer, customs clearance, and transit bonding to Uganda, Rwanda, DRC, and South Sudan.
Nairobi Warehouse: Strategic distribution hub for Kenya and regional exports — perfect for inventory serving local and East African markets.
Importers & Exporters – Temporary storage before customs clearance
Manufacturers – Raw material and finished goods storage
Distributors & Wholesalers – Regional inventory hubs
E-commerce Businesses – Fulfillment and last-mile distribution
Project Cargo Clients – Temporary storage for equipment and machinery

blocks.title: How the warehousing process works
items: Step 1: Request a quote with your storage requirements (cargo type, volume, duration, location)
Step 2: We assign space and provide access terms based on your needs
Step 3: Cargo receipt and inventory registration with real-time tracking
Step 4: Real-time inventory tracking and reporting throughout storage period
Step 5: Release and distribution as needed, including pick & pack services

blocks.title: Warehousing questions
blocks.body: Need a dedicated page? We also published a focused guide for customs bonded warehouse Kenya covering when bonded storage makes sense, who uses it, and how duty-deferred handling fits into the clearance process. Read the bonded warehouse guide .
items:
What warehousing services does Kenya Tradex provide? 
Kenya Tradex supports bonded storage, private warehousing, 24/7 security, inventory management, pick & pack services, cross-docking and onward distribution planning in Mombasa and Nairobi.

What is bonded warehousing? 
Bonded warehousing allows imported cargo to be stored under customs control before duty is settled for local release, subject to applicable customs rules and storage conditions.

Do you support short-term and longer-term storage? 
Yes. Kenya Tradex supports storage planning for short-term (daily/weekly) and long-term (monthly/yearly) warehousing needs depending on cargo type and handling requirements.

Is your warehouse secure with 24/7 monitoring? 
Yes. Kenya Tradex facilities feature 24/7 security and CCTV monitoring to ensure your cargo is protected at all times.
